items.title: The Chinese remainder theorem for pairwise comaximal ideals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the Chinese remainder theorem: for pairwise comaximal ideals the intersection equals the product and the quotient by the product splits as a product of the quotients, with the case of pairwise distinct maximal ideals as a corollary (statement lines 2832-2844). The proof does not quote the theorem: it proves the intersection identity by a partition-of-unity argument, gets injectivity from it, and constructs explicit elements with prescribed residues for surjectivity (proof lines 2846-2882). The explicit construction of the residues is the step that carries surjectivity. H2.
